environment: local isolated openaliment_tests; email captured to private test file, no real SMTP delivery

checks.name: Home migration additive and repeatable
Request does not create an unverified account
Link preview is read-only and does not consume token
Magic link is single use
Consumer principal separate from producer accounts
Missing private CSRF rejected
Valid private CSRF accepted
Second device reaches same household
First package and history commit together
Retry after lost response does not duplicate events
Same operation ID with changed content rejected
Pagination cursor reaches package and history without losing either
Device cannot claim current safety checks
Another household sees no inventory
Cross-household principal cannot read another household
Health preferences are not accepted by sync
Private recipe fields cannot enter inventory
Concurrent edit returns conflict and writes no partial batch
Conflict preserves current version
Explicit resolution creates new audited revision
Undo add is a versioned tombstone, not history erasure
Private photo upload is idempotent
Other household cannot download private photo
Invalid photo is not executable or accepted
Item cannot reference missing private photo
Invite preview does not consume invitation
Invite is single use
Accepted invite grants household access only
Editor cannot invite as owner
Removed member immediately loses server access
Revoked device cannot authenticate
Revoking one device leaves another active
